summary: Frontend-only retest of Iteration 18 Move-Building ROOF-grab fix at 390x844. ALL 6 review items PASS. VERIFIED (in one continuous session): (1) City screen reached (menu-new-game -> mode-single -> start-game -> Skip -> map click (195,420) -> enter-city -> city-screen). (2) Material Factory placed via place-layer drag; renders as raised 3D iso box with white factory icon on the roof (overlay bbox: 156,487 - 78x39, i.e. base diamond; icon+roof drawn ABOVE that at ~y=443..475). (3) MOVE FROM ROOF (the regression under test): Edit -> edit-move mounts move-layer; pressed at (194.99, 481) — that y-coordinate is ABOVE the base overlay top (y=487), i.e. on the visible roof/icon face — and dragged to (295, 561). During drag, GREEN ghost fill 'rgba(80,200,110,0.4)' present in DOM; on release, factory relocated from (156,487) to (221, 545) confirming buildingAt's downward probe (FACTORY_H / FACTORY_H+14 / FACTORY_H*0.5) now catches the roof grab AND moveUpdate's elev offset keeps the ghost footprint under the finger. Previously this drag returned null in buildingAt and the move silently failed. (4) MOVE FROM BASE still works: dragged from (194.99, 578*0.75) to left+down, GREEN ghost appeared, factory relocated to (156,578). (5) INVALID DROP still guarded: dragged factory ghost onto citadel center (195,420); DOM contained RED ghost 'rgba(220,70,70,0.4)' during drag; on release factory did NOT move (position unchanged). (6) REGRESSIONS: edit-demolish -> tap factory -> factory overlay removed. city-exit unmounts city-screen; action-end-turn pressed 2x on world screen without red-screen crash. Deprecation warnings (shadow*, props.pointerEvents, style.resizeMode) still print — pre-existing/cosmetic. Note: 'Building moved' toast text was not asserted-caught (setTimeout 1.6s + async race in Playwright query), but the visual + bounding-box relocation is the authoritative success signal and both ROOF and BASE drags actually moved the building.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing RN-Web deprecation warnings carried over from prior iterations. Cosmetic only. Reference: repeated console warnings on every screen mount.

action_items: No action required — the iteration 17 HIGH bug (ROOF-grab miss in CityMap.buildingAt) is now fixed. Downward probes for factory (dy in [FACTORY_H, FACTORY_H+14, FACTORY_H*0.5]) at CityMap.tsx:165-169 plus the +elev offset in moveUpdate at CityMap.tsx:183-184 together resolve both the hit-test and the footprint-tracking half of the bug.

(Optional, non-blocking, carried over) Hoist commitStroke / commitGhost / moveEnd callbacks out of setState updaters to eliminate potential React-18 setState-in-render warning. Reference: CityMap.tsx:111-117, :138-143, :192-196.
critical_code_review_comments: CityMap.tsx:158-172 buildingAt now correctly handles elevated buildings: for each factory it re-projects the finger point three additional times (by + FACTORY_H, + FACTORY_H+14, + FACTORY_H*0.5) and returns the first building whose footprint contains the shifted cell. The base-plane probe still runs first so non-elevated buildings are unaffected. Solid targeted fix.

CityMap.tsx:179-191 moveUpdate applies the same +FACTORY_H elevation offset when the picked building is a factory. This keeps the ghost footprint anchored under the visual grab point (the roof), rather than jumping down by 32px on the first onChange event. Verified visually — the green ghost tracks the finger smoothly from the roof grab.

CityMap.tsx:270 the moving factory's 3D box is rendered at 0.3 opacity while dragging (moveGhost?.id === b.id), and the ghost's own factoryBox is drawn at 0.85 opacity — good visual affordance for the user during a roof-start drag.

city.tsx:69 onMoveBuilding wires to doMoveCityBuilding with haptic + 'Building moved' toast; canMoveTo uses canPlaceCityBuilding with excludeBuildingId so the building can be dropped on its own footprint cells — behaves correctly across all three drag tests.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 review items pass — ROOF-grab regression fixed; BASE drag, invalid-drop guard, demolish, exit + end-turn all still green)

seed_data_creation: None — fresh single-player game via New Game flow (default Lesnoi tribe). Placed a Material Factory near map center, moved it ROOF-drag -> BASE-drag, attempted invalid drop over citadel (rejected), demolished, exited, ended turn twice.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reach city-screen: menu-new-game -> mode-single -> start-game -> skip tutorial -> mouse.click(195,420) -> enter-city -> [data-testid=city-screen]. Viewport 390x844. Place a factory: city-buildings -> build-factory (dispatch pointerdown+pointerup+click via JS if RN Pressable is outside the pinned tab-order viewport) -> place-layer -> mouse drag to place. To test ROOF-grab, query the factory's Pressable overlay [data-testid^='factory-'] BEFORE entering move mode (in move mode the Pressable overlay is unmounted, see CityMap.tsx:311). The overlay bounds the BASE DIAMOND; the visible roof face sits ABOVE it, so a press at y = overlay.y - 6 (up to ~30px above) hits the roof/icon. Drag with page.mouse.down + >=12 small moves + up. Ghost detection: search page.content() for 'rgba(80,200,110,0.4)' (green ok) or 'rgba(220,70,70,0.4)' (red bad). Success signal is the post-drag factory overlay bbox differing from the pre-drag bbox by >8px (the 'Building moved' toast disappears after 1.6s so bbox delta is more reliable than the toast).
rca_of_issue: N/A — retest confirms iteration 17's HIGH bug is resolved. Fix applied in CityMap.tsx: (a) buildingAt at lines 158-172 now additionally probes cellFor(bx, by + dy) for dy in [FACTORY_H=32, FACTORY_H+14=46, FACTORY_H*0.5=16] when the candidate building is a factory, so a press on the visible top face / white icon (drawn at mid.y - (FACTORY_H+12) = ~44px above the base) resolves to a cell inside the footprint and returns the building. (b) moveUpdate at lines 179-191 applies the same +FACTORY_H offset to the projection during drag, so the ghost tracks the finger's grab point (on the roof) rather than snapping the footprint 32px below the pointer on the first move event. Verified end-to-end: green ghost appears immediately on roof-press, footprint tracks smoothly, release relocates the building. All other flows (base drag, invalid-drop, demolish, exit, end-turn) remain green.
